description: A overgrown garden path between the shoebox houses. Tall blades of grass (well, tall for a shoe) sway in the breeze. The path branches off in several directions.

wall.description: A dense thicket of weeds and dandelion stems.

grass.description: Soft, green grass that feels like velvet under your sole.

swaying_clover.onInteract: You examine the giant four-leaf clover. It's incredibly lucky! You feel a sudden surge of starchy confidence.
swaying_clover.description: A massive, lucky four-leaf clover swaying gently in the breeze.

sprouted_dandelion.onInteract: You tickle the dandelion puff. A cloud of golden seeds floats into the air, dancing in the light. It's beautiful.
sprouted_dandelion.description: A brilliant yellow dandelion sprouted between the cardboard cracks.

item.name: Wild Potato
item.opened_description: A dense tangle of dandelions. The soil is empty.
item.onCollect: You dig through the clover and harvest a plump, fresh Wild Potato!

overgrown_patch.description: A dense tangle of overgrown dandelions and clover. Something round and starchy is buried in the soil!

exit_north.description: A precarious-looking trellis leads up toward the attic window sill.

exit_west.description: The path leads west back to the neighbor's house.
